summary: Iter 194 — Firewall→Auditor + Firewall→FinanceBot integration + Firewall Panel UX upgrades. (3) GET /api/firewall/status live snapshot returns summary with balance_health_percent + lifetime_rejections. Settings panel toggles open showing all 5 settings testids (rejection-threshold, health-percent, refresh-interval, enable-alerts, settings-panel). Audit run flow: button text changes 'تشغيل تدقيق المحاسبة' → 'جارٍ التدقيق...' during run, then firewall-audit-result-card appears with firewall-audit-fw-status='ok'. CSV export button click does NOT error and triggers firewall-toast (no rejections to export → toast feedback shown). Copy-report click does not error. Changing rejection-threshold to 1 surfaces firewall-toast as expected. Open-assistant button correctly navigates to /ai-financial. Rejection-detail modal could NOT be exercised because lifetime_rejections=0 on this fresh DB (no firewall-rejection-row present); UI gracefully shows empty state — this is by design and matches the task note from main agent.

critical_code_review_comments: accounting_auditor.check_firewall_health is well-structured: cleanly maps summary→metrics, distinguishes critical (unbalanced_db_count, drift>threshold) vs warning (rejections≥20, missing COGS) vs ok, and feeds the auditor's corrections_needed list — good integration.

routes_finance_bot.build_firewall_context is wrapped in try/except and called both in fallback (no-findings) mode AND should ideally also be appended in the main interactive Findings-flow (currently only in fallback branch around line 638). Consider including the firewall snapshot in every LLM prompt regardless of session state for stronger live awareness.
FINANCE_SYSTEM_PROMPT correctly instructs the assistant to use '🛡️ حالة جدار حماية المحاسبة' context — good.
FirewallPanel.jsx exposes a clean, complete data-testid surface; all interactive elements are addressable. Live pulse animates, settings persist within the session.
Minor: CSV export uses Blob API; in some headless test envs the actual download won't trigger but the click handler safely no-ops via toast — verified.
